title: Learning Quantum Data Distribution via Chaotic Quantum Diffusion Model
abstract: arXiv:2602.22061v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative models for quantum data pose significant challenges but hold immense potential in fields such as chemoinformatics and quantum physics. Quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic models (QuDDPMs) enable efficient learning of quantum data distributions by progressively scrambling and denoising quantum states. However, existing implementations typically rely on circuit-based random unitary dynamics, which can be costly to implement and sensitive to control imperfections, particularly on analog quantum hardware. We propose the chaotic quantum diffusion model, a framework that generates projected ensembles via chaotic Hamiltonian time evolution, providing a flexible and hardware-compatible diffusion mechanism. Requiring only global, time-independent control, our approach substantially reduces implementation overhead across diverse analog quantum platforms while achieving accuracy comparable to QuDDPMs. This method improves

translated_title: 通过混沌量子扩散模型学习量子数据分布
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.22061v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：量子数据的生成模型面临重大挑战，但在化学信息学和量子物理等领域具有巨大潜力。量子去噪扩散概率模型（QuDDPMs）通过逐步扰乱和去噪量子态，能够高效地学习量子数据分布。然而，现有的实现通常依赖于基于线路的随机酉动力学，其实现成本高昂，且对控制缺陷十分敏感，尤其是在模拟量子硬件上。我们提出了混沌量子扩散模型，这是一个通过混沌哈密顿量时间演化来生成投影系综的框架，提供了一种灵活且与硬件兼容的扩散机制。我们的方法仅需要全局的、与时间无关的控制，因此在多种模拟量子平台上大幅降低了实现开销，同时达到了与QuDDPM相当的精度。该方法改进了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过混沌哈密顿量时间演化生成投影系综的混沌量子扩散模型，仅需全局时不变控制即可在多种模拟量子平台上大幅降低实现开销，同时保持与现有量子去噪扩散概率模型相当的精度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a chaotic quantum diffusion model that generates projected ensembles via chaotic Hamiltonian time evolution, requiring only global time-independent control to substantially reduce implementation overhead across diverse analog quantum platforms while achieving accuracy comparable to QuDDPMs.
